title: Ovid2 semantic column bindings
description: One binding YAML file attaches a set of ColumnBinding rows to a single CDM. Phase S3 introduced the file format so cross-CDM vocabularies (LOINC, SNOMED, RxNorm, NDC, ICD10CM, ICD9CM) can wire themselves onto CDM columns without editing Python. Loaded by ovid2.semantic.vocabularies._yaml_loader at import time; referential integrity (vocabulary registered, cdm+table known) is checked at load and enforced non-fatally (unknown rows are warned + skipped).

v.description: Schema version. Bumped on breaking changes.

cdm.description: Snake_case CDM name that every binding in this file targets.

description.description: Free-form summary shown in ovid2 semantic bindings output.

valueset.description: Optional named valueset within the vocabulary. Reserved for a future ValueSetBinding sibling.

required.description: When true, strict formatter validation (opt-in, phase S4) fails if the column is not produced through a semantic-aware path.
